about: Scenarios (docs/ENGINEERING_SYSTEM.md section 3.2). State is derived from the proof each names; a scenario is never itself proof. PROTOCOL-class: changing this file needs an approval record.

scenarios.name: A sender mark never touches what the person already accepted
given: a loop and two commitments the person accepted
when: the sender it came from is marked quiet, then taken back
then: exactly the grant and the answer are added
every loop and commitment is as it was
mustNot: a loop closed, altered or erased by a mark

proof.check: every loop and commitment event is exactly as it was
exactly two events were added: the grant and the answer
the loop and the commitments are still as accepted

scenarios.name: Everything from a quiet sender is noise, whatever it says
given: a bank whose messages would form loops
then: all its messages are noise, tagged sender, and the cost is counted
mustNot: a loop from a quiet sender

proof.check: all three of its messages are noise, tagged sender
and the cost is counted: the three that were loops
every service message is still in exactly one role

scenarios.name: Time passing never closes a loop
given: an open loop with a date

proof.check: a year later it is still overdue: absence is never closure
it is overdue the day after
nothing in the fold moves a loop to done on its own

scenarios.name: Evidence that only suggests changes no state
given: a loop and a closing observation known only by inference
then: the state is unchanged until the person confirms
mustNot: a state change from a suggestion

proof.check: evidence that suggests it is closed does not change the state
a closing by you is a change
